title: Shifted spreadsheet rows in observation sections
situation: Several synthetic Excel observation rows omitted a leading cell, shifting plot IDs, dates, and layer boundaries into adjacent columns.
what_happened: The first validator runs found malformed dates and reversed or incomplete soil boundaries.
lesson: Detect omitted leading cells from the row pattern before mapping, recover dates from the source row, and normalize soil boundaries together.

title: Canonical crop vocabulary required
situation: Genotype records needed a crop identifier while the source only indicated synthetic wheat-like experiment data.
what_happened: The validator rejected the provisional WH value as an unknown crop code.
lesson: Use the canonical Crop_codes vocabulary; the accepted wheat code for this package is WHT.

title: Weather monthly row iteration
situation: The dedicated monthly weather workbook contains a header followed by many observation rows.
what_happened: Treating the section payload as one row produced list text in the year field and the validator rejected it.
lesson: Iterate every row in the section data and map each monthly observation independently.

title: Workbook section offsets
situation: Experiment workbook sections used a leading source row identifier that was omitted from the displayed section headers, while metadata sections used a different alignment.
what_happened: The first rebuilt package lost or shifted planting, management, initial-layer, and observation values; the row-count audit exposed unexpectedly empty or undersized tables.
lesson: Use the workbook section marker and source row identifier to apply the correct positional offset per section, and verify section row counts before validation.

title: Weather YYDDD and malformed numeric tokens
situation: Weather files mixed YYDDD and YYYYDDD dates and contained numeric tokens with a trailing E.
what_happened: The official validator rejected non-ISO dates and values such as 2.1738798649974735E.
lesson: Normalize all weather dates to ISO format and strip a source trailing E only from numeric weather tokens before writing Weather_daily.

title: Skipping rows that fail a format check
situation: A source section failed date validation because its values sat in shifted columns.
what_happened: The agent filtered out every row without an ISO date, so the target tables came out empty while the validator still passed.
lesson: When a field fails a format check, first check whether the columns are shifted against the header and fix the alignment. Never skip or blank source rows or values to satisfy the validator. An empty table with matching source data is a bug even when the validator accepts it.

title: Row count audit without real source column
situation: The checklist requires a row count and source file for every output table.
what_happened: A syntax error led the agent to print a placeholder instead of the source file, and it then reported the audit as done while 22 tables were empty.
lesson: Print the real source file or section for every table and list each 0-row table next to the section that should feed it. Do not report the audit as done until every empty table is filled or explained from the source.

title: Parser change without regression check
situation: A shared section parser applied a positional offset that differed between section types.
what_happened: The offset was changed about eight times and a late change shrank Genotypes and Harvest_events unnoticed, because only a few tables were re-counted.
lesson: Decide the offset per section type once from the row pattern. After any parser change, re-count every output table and compare with the previous counts before continuing.

title: SADATid soil laboratory header
situation: DSSAT workbooks used both SADAT and SADATid header labels for the same dated soil laboratory section.
what_happened: The first build only recognized SADAT and produced 2 soil layer observation rows despite many source SADATid records.
lesson: Recognize both SADAT and SADATid source header variants when routing dated soil laboratory records to Soil_layer_observations_timeseries.

title: Shifted irrigation and fertilizer columns
situation: Workbook management sections used different placeholder-column layouts around irrigation and fertilizer fields.
what_happened: Irrigation amounts and operation codes, and some fertilizer cells, were initially assigned to the wrong target fields and failed numeric/code validation.
lesson: Normalize management section fields by type and layout before mapping amounts, operations, and material codes.

title: Configuration observation storage
situation: The target scheme declares physical values in soil and initial configuration tables as observation references.
what_happened: Direct numeric values in configuration fields failed final validation because those fields require obs references.
lesson: Keep direct physical values in observation tables and leave configuration physical slots blank unless complete declared obs references are built.

title: Unused parent records
situation: Source soil and weather libraries contained profiles and stations not selected by any canonical plot-season context.
what_happened: Final validation rejected unreferenced parent profiles and a weather station.
lesson: Only emit parent profiles and stations with a source-supported plot-season path; document unreferenced alternatives outside the final relational package.

title: Recover XML numbers from date-formatted amount cells
situation: Irrigation amounts and crop nitrogen fields were numeric cells displayed by Excel as dates or midnight times.
what_happened: Build conversion checks found 1900 dates and midnight strings where measured numeric amounts belonged. Raw worksheet XML retained the original numbers.
lesson: For numeric source definitions, recover the stored XML numeric value rather than interpreting Excel display formatting as a measurement type.

title: Dictionary target identities require CSV filenames
situation: Dictionary mappings used table names without filename suffixes.
what_happened: The official validator reported unknown_target_variable for otherwise correct target fields; appending .csv and explicit unreported source-unit metadata fixed the mappings.
lesson: Use the exact target filename, including .csv, in every Dictionary target_file identity.

title: Restore swapped irrigation amount and method columns
situation: SYN04 irrigation rows placed IR method codes under the amount header and numeric amounts under the method header.
what_happened: A numeric conversion check exposed the swap; field definitions and source value types supported restoring amount and method without losing any events.
lesson: Detect complementary numeric/code column swaps from both source definitions and value patterns before mapping irrigation events.

title: Missing horizon markers are not category codes
situation: A DSSAT profile used a dash in its master-horizon field.
what_happened: Official validation rejected the dash as an unknown code; treating the source dash as missing preserved every layer and its other measurements.
lesson: Normalize documented missing markers before categorical mapping rather than treating them as horizon codes.

title: Repair misplaced layer IDs before inferring boundaries
situation: SYN09 row52 carried context25 despite completing context16 layer sequence.
what_happened: Official validation found reversed intervals in the following block; restoring row52 to16 preserved all values and yielded the supported20/40/65/90cm sequences.
lesson: Resolve a misplaced layer-context ID from the full source block before computing successive top boundaries.

title: No-irrigation prose belongs at treatment grain
situation: Source irrigation sections contained rain-fed and explicit no-irrigation statements instead of dated events.
what_happened: Official validation rejected a prose date and an untimed empty event; zero seasonal irrigation with source comments retained the real information without fabricated event timing.
lesson: Store explicit no-irrigation statements as treatment summaries, not empty or invented dated irrigation events.

title: Inspect adjacent samples before repairing stale January years
situation: Seven crop sample dates retained the previous year across December to January.
what_happened: Official crop-season checks caught the out-of-season dates; neighboring14-day samples established the next year, and original dates were retained in evidence.
lesson: Repair cross-year sample typos only when adjacent source chronology establishes the intended year, and preserve the original date.

title: Audit populated source columns as well as row counts
situation: A dated soil row contained four SW layer values alongside nitrate and ammonium.
what_happened: The package passed validation but a nonempty-cell completeness audit found SW values omitted; mapping them to soil_water_by_layer preserved the four measurements.
lesson: Compare populated source variable cells with output coverage, because correct row counts can still hide omitted SW layer measurements.

title: Source-key reconciliation can recover unmatched series aliases
situation: Six SYN10 observations used IDs104/110 with no metadata parents.
what_happened: The source-count audit exposed their omission; the human approved104 to4 and110 to10, and all six rows were restored with original IDs and proposed Dictionary mapping.
lesson: Investigate every unmatched source measurement ID during count reconciliation and obtain an explicit identity decision rather than silently omitting the rows.

title: Do not infer KCl extraction from nitrogen concentration units
situation: Dated source nitrate and ammonium concentrations reported ugN/g soil without an extraction method.
what_happened: A semantic review caught an unsupported mapping to extraction-specific fields; method-unspecified proposed concentration fields retained the physical measurements.
lesson: Matching concentration units do not justify an extraction-specific variable when the source assay method is unknown.

title: Normalize literal ISO date component widths
situation: The workbook contained planting date 2004-05-3.
what_happened: The build parser stopped on the one-digit day. The parser was corrected to parse calendar components and emit 2004-05-03.
lesson: Normalize component widths without changing the source calendar date.

title: Recover numeric Excel serials by field context
situation: Irrigation and crop numeric cells were formatted as Excel dates or times.
what_happened: Official writer errors exposed strings such as 1901-10-17 in numeric fields. The build now reverses Excel formatting only for numeric targets, preserving true calendar fields.
lesson: Use target numeric meaning to distinguish an Excel serial from a calendar date.

title: Dictionary targets require exact CSV identities
situation: Dictionary targets initially used bare table names.
what_happened: The official Dictionary writer rejected unknown targets. Target filenames were changed to Table.csv and new variable codes received explicit namespaces.
lesson: Construct Dictionary target identities from the exact official table filename and variable metadata.

title: Preserve unregistered fertilizer method AP010
situation: Source FEACD included AP010, absent from the registered field vocabulary.
what_happened: The official writer rejected AP010. A namespaced package-local category preserves the source identifier with its unspecified operation explicitly documented.
lesson: Preserve unknown method categories without inventing their agronomic meaning.

title: Master horizon dash is not a category
situation: A selected soil layer supplied SLMH as a dash.
what_happened: The official writer rejected the dash as an unknown horizon code. The output horizon is blank while the raw source token remains in provenance.
lesson: Treat an unspecified horizon token as missing instead of inventing a horizon category.

title: Use field-specific fertilizer logical codes
situation: Fertilizer application flags used Y then 1 during the build.
what_happened: The official writer rejected both; the official fertilizer logical vocabulary requires Yes and No, unlike the irrigation Y/N vocabulary.
lesson: Consult the field-specific logical vocabulary rather than transferring codes from another field.

title: Parse terminal E tokens without inventing exponents
situation: SYN02.WTH numeric values ended in E without an exponent.
what_happened: The official numeric writer rejected these tokens. Counterpart scenario values confirmed the mantissas and expected temperature offset; raw tokens were preserved and only the numeric mantissa stored.
lesson: Use corroborating source evidence for malformed numeric suffixes and retain the unexplained suffix in provenance.

title: Profile depth is an observation-backed configuration
situation: Soil profile heading depth was initially written directly to Soil_profiles.soil_depth.
what_happened: The official writer rejected a direct numeric configuration value. Depth was stored at profile scope in soil observations and selected through a complete-key reference.
lesson: Respect declared observation storage even for profile-heading depth.

title: Repair year rollover from actual series chronology
situation: Seven January crop observations carried the prior season year.
what_happened: The official final validator flagged dates outside the linked season. Adjacent fourteen-day series chronology and planting/harvest evidence supported advancing only the erroneous year, with raw dates recorded.
lesson: Repair calendar typos from within-source chronology rather than deleting out-of-season measurements.

title: Prior DITY harvest decision had different evidence
situation: A saved DITY1982 correction described date-only October rows.
what_happened: Applying it to the current source caused official season errors because the current October rows contain real measurements. The correction was removed and current source-supported harvest dates retained.
lesson: Reuse a prior decision only when its stated evidence conditions match the current records.

title: Count reconciliation reveals misplaced layer ID
situation: There were 108 source initial layers but only 107 output rows.
what_happened: The source count audit found SYN09 row52 ID25 inside the ID16 layer block, duplicating the ID25 bottom layer and leaving ID16 incomplete. Row52 was assigned to ID16 with its original values and documented inference.
lesson: Investigate every lost layer count before consolidating duplicate keys.

title: Recover duplicate summary ID using phenology and yield
situation: SYN10 had a repeated summary ID19 and no summary for context22.
what_happened: The source coverage audit showed the second ID19 row matched context22 on emergence, harvest and yield. The build repairs that row-specific association and preserves the raw identifier in comments.
lesson: Use several source correspondences to resolve a missing summary identity rather than merging distinct summaries.

title: Map by physical definition when source aliases differ
situation: Nonempty source columns were still explicitly excluded during the completeness audit.
what_happened: The audit exposed TDAT tuber initiation, !CYAD tops fresh weight, and generic nitrate/ammonium layer observations. Exact fields TDAT, CFWAD, NOSLD and NHSLD restored the data without adding assay qualifiers.
lesson: Match source definitions and chemical forms before relying on literal code similarity.

title: Preserve annual DITY management register grain
situation: The source explicitly named DITY annual IRR, FERT and ORG registers.
what_happened: The source count audit found shared protocols initially repeated for all five cultivar contexts. The build now stores each annual source register once and links all represented plot-seasons to it.
lesson: Use explicit shared source management identities instead of manufacturing per-plot protocol copies.

title: Do not map total carbon into stable carbon
situation: SYN08 selected a dated organic-carbon campaign as an initial baseline.
what_happened: Definition inspection showed ICSC means stable carbon, not the reported total carbon. A fully documented proposed total-carbon baseline observation and configuration selector preserves the source protocol, dates and boundaries.
lesson: Keep total and stable organic-carbon pool identities separate even when units match.

title: Preserve source adsorption scale basis
situation: The spreadsheet SLADC definition states a dimensionless zero-to-one scale.
what_happened: The semantic completeness audit found a mismatch with the existing volume-per-mass adsorption field. The source is now a documented proposed dimensionless field instead.
lesson: Do not assign volume-per-mass units to a source-defined dimensionless coefficient.

title: Select corroborated tuber fresh-weight endpoint
situation: SYN08:4 final series cell reported 1.73 Mg/ha, but its summary and PULU counterpart reported17.3.
what_happened: The competing-key audit identified the conflict. The corroborated endpoint17.3 Mg/ha was selected; the raw alternative and unresolved earlier curve discrepancy were documented.
lesson: Resolve a conflicting endpoint using matching source records without silently rescaling the entire growth curve.

title: Initial-state code variants hid source layers
situation: Initial-layer count reconciliation initially found only56 output rows for100 distinct source layers.
what_happened: The parser recognized ICH2O but ignored initial-condition sections using SH2O/SNH4/SNO3. Section-aware aliases restored every source layer.
lesson: Recognize soil-state code variants by section purpose before counting or routing initial layers.

title: Bracketed fresh-mass units need complete unit parsing
situation: A duplicate endpoint comparison found17.3 versus17300 for matching tuber fresh-weight reports.
what_happened: The source unit Mg [fm]/ha was not matched by a parser expecting Mg/ha. Supporting the bracketed basis restored the correct kg/ha values.
lesson: Parse mass scale and basis annotations separately when converting Mg [fm]/ha to kg/ha.

title: Do not invent biomass-carbon conversions
situation: Review of harvest observations against the full units contract caught a0.40 factor in the build.
what_happened: The unsupported dry-matter-to-carbon conversion was removed and all affected observations were rebuilt from original dry-matter values.
lesson: A dry-weight field must stay dry weight unless both source meaning and target definition explicitly require carbon.

title: Numbered soil-state columns are not crop variables
situation: Unmapped-code review found NI1D through NI4D, NH1D through NH4D and SW1D through SW4D.
what_happened: The single wide dated soil-state row was expanded to four source-supported layer records; method-neutral water and proposed method-unspecified mineral-N fields preserved all12 values.
lesson: Expand numbered soil-layer columns at their actual soil observation grain instead of excluding them from a crop-series parser.

title: Separate workbook soil inventory needs its own observation scope
situation: Source-file coverage review found a Soils sheet after library-based tables had already been populated.
what_happened: The SOIL06 workbook inventory was added as shared observations with its own intervals while preserving the independent library configuration.
lesson: Read every workbook sheet and preserve parallel soil inventories without replacing independent configurations or merging incompatible layer systems.

title: Singleton observation groups are required links
situation: The complete official validator rejected blank group_plot_season_ids on individually scoped observations.
what_happened: Singleton groups were filled with the actual source plot-season ID and configuration references rebuilt with the complete key.
lesson: An individual observation still needs its own plot-season in the required group link.

title: Initial scalar properties must be observation references
situation: The official writer rejected direct residue mass in Initial_conditions.
what_happened: Actual initial scalar values were stored in soil observations and Initial_conditions selected the corresponding observation cells.
lesson: Inspect Storage metadata before writing configuration properties; direct numeric values belong in their declared observation sources.

title: Normalize numeric primary-key representations
situation: The official validator identified a duplicate soil observation key whose boundaries were40 and40.0.
what_happened: Numeric key components were normalized before merging, retaining compatible property values in one record.
lesson: Canonicalize numeric key representations before constructing logical observation keys.

title: Rainfed declaration rows are not application events
situation: The official validator found irrigation rows with treatment IDs but no timing.
what_happened: Raw rows said No irrigation was applied and Rain-fed; they became linked treatment declarations rather than fabricated event rows.
lesson: Classify explicit no-irrigation source rows as treatment information, not dated applications.

title: Repeated comment headers can erase declarations
situation: One rainfed declaration remained unclassified after checking a code-keyed row dictionary.
what_happened: Repeated exclamation-mark headers had overwritten the cell containing Rain-fed; classification was changed to inspect the raw row cells.
lesson: Do not rely on a code-keyed dictionary to retain values from repeated comment-column headers.

title: Normalize unpadded ISO source dates
situation: The official validator found a required planting date blank in SYN04:13.
what_happened: The source value was2004-05-3 with whitespace; date normalization restored2004-05-03 without estimating a date.
lesson: Recognize unpadded ISO dates before treating a required date as absent.

title: Recover complementary irrigation amount-method swaps
situation: The official writer rejected irrigation_operation35.2.
what_happened: The source row placed an IR code in the amount column and a number in the operation column; complementary typed values were swapped back.
lesson: Repair amount-method swaps only when both source fields provide complementary numeric/code evidence.

title: Dated campaigns require successive sampled boundaries
situation: Review of the SYN08 dated organic-carbon campaign found every sample assigned top depth0.
what_happened: Assay layer bases15,30,60,100 were converted to successive intervals within that context and date.
lesson: Infer successive sampled tops within each campaign and context, resetting for a new date rather than making all samples start at zero.

title: Use exact phenology code identities
situation: Unmapped-source review showed PLDAE, HDATE and TDAT dates absent from summaries.
what_happened: Unnecessary aliases to different codes were removed and exact target code identities used.
lesson: Check the target code dictionary before creating aliases for source phenology dates.

title: Harvest weight is not maturity weight
situation: Semantic review found source TWAT Total wt harvest mapped to TWAM.
what_happened: The mapping was corrected to TWAH, with tops-specific CWAH only for source-supported correspondence to final CWAD.
lesson: Preserve harvest versus maturity scope even when both targets share kg/ha.

title: Apply authoritative factorial N schedules without losing P and K
situation: Source-versus-treatment review found positive N in PULU treatments named N0.
what_happened: The prior human decision h077 and matched protocol were applied to the reported split dates; P/K events and raw N values were preserved.
lesson: Use explicitly matched treatment-design evidence to resolve misassigned fertilizer rates, while retaining independently reported nutrient events.

title: Keep generated processing notes out of original comments
situation: Final provenance review found generated correction explanations concatenated into source_comments.
what_happened: Generated human-decision, endpoint and unknown-code notes were separated into ai_comments before the final write.
lesson: Preserve original comments verbatim in source_comments and put transformation explanations in ai_comments.

title: Station source headers need field-specific aliases
situation: The row-count review found populated station IDs but missing station coordinates.
what_happened: LAT/LONG/ELEV source header codes were mapped explicitly to WST_LAT/WST_LONG/WST_ELEV target fields.
lesson: Do not assume daily-weather and station-metadata header codes match the same target-code naming convention.

title: Comment numbers may end with sentence punctuation
situation: The first comment-event build stopped on environmental value0.79 followed by a full stop.
what_happened: Terminal sentence punctuation was removed from numeric comment tokens without changing the reported factor.
lesson: Separate numeric tokens from surrounding prose punctuation when parsing management comments.

title: Unknown application codes do not authorize invented methods
situation: The official writer rejected fertilizer method AP010.
what_happened: No registered meaning was established, so the event retained its date/nutrients/depth and the raw method code moved to processing provenance with the standardized method left unknown.
lesson: Preserve an unregistered source category without inventing a standardized physical meaning.

title: Derived monthly weather requires its own Dictionary relationships
situation: Final source coverage review found432 monthly rows but no monthly source-to-target Dictionary mappings.
what_happened: Per-file SRAD/TMAX/TMIN/RAIN aggregation mappings and DATE-to-year/month grouping mappings were added; the official complete/final validator passed after the last output change.
lesson: When deriving an additional table from existing source variables, record each new source-to-target relationship and its aggregation rule rather than relying only on the daily mappings.

title: UYFAD alias can suppress fresh tuber rows
situation: Observed UYFAD and UYAD source values did not appear under the fresh-tuber target.
what_happened: The observed-field exclusion and source-count audit exposed an erroneous UYFAD-to-UYAD alias; restoring the canonical UYFAD target recovered 15 additional dated rows and missing values on existing rows.
lesson: Resolve aliases against the exact target Code_Display before excluding an observed source field.

title: Recover fractional serials from date-formatted numeric cells
situation: Numeric biomass and nitrogen cells were formatted as Excel dates.
what_happened: A source-format audit found 102 nonmidnight datetimes. The initial extraction had retained only their calendar dates; preserving full datetime values and converting them to Excel serials recovered the fractional numeric values.
lesson: When a numeric measurement is date-formatted, recover its complete Excel serial including the fractional day rather than truncating to the date.

title: Apply fertilizer oxide conversions only on stated oxide basis
situation: SYN10 fertilizer source units explicitly reported P2O5 and K2O.
what_happened: The final unit audit found that these had initially been loaded as elemental amounts. Applying atomic-mass factors to only those oxide-labeled columns corrected P and K while leaving explicitly elemental columns unchanged.
lesson: Inspect each source unit for P2O5 or K2O before mapping FEAMP or FEAMK to elemental nutrients.

title: Coalesce irrigation copies across ownership-linked exports
situation: Primary workbooks and PULU0801 repeated identical 40 mm applications under the same canonical contexts and dates.
what_happened: The source overlap audit showed that additive event consolidation had doubled repeated export amounts. The build now coalesces cross-workbook copies while retaining their provenance.
lesson: Establish whether same-key applications are duplicate exports or distinct additive records before summing amounts.

title: Hidden workbook soil inventory can describe another experiment
situation: The Soils sheet inside SYN07.xlsx explicitly identified profile SOIL06.
what_happened: The observed-field completeness audit found its populated properties were excluded. Loading the sheet under its stated profile identity restored field observations and selected the four-layer SOIL06 configuration without dropping the alternative SOL observations.
lesson: Use the explicit profile ID inside a workbook soil sheet rather than inferring ownership from the workbook filename.

title: Misplaced SYN09 layer ID must be repaired before intervals
situation: SYN09 row52 carried context25 while completing the context16 layer block.
what_happened: The official validator exposed a 90-to-20 cm reversed interval. Restoring row52 to context16 using adjacent bases and its temperature-interval comment preserved all 100 unique initial-layer rows.
lesson: Resolve a misplaced source layer-context ID before calculating successive top boundaries.

title: Calendar conflicts need corroboration rather than row omission
situation: Several source emergence, January measurement and harvest dates contradicted linked crop seasons.
what_happened: Official temporal checks identified the conflicts. Adjacent growth-series dates, final samples and the explicit calendar register supported specific day-month, year-rollover and harvest corrections; original evidence remained documented.
lesson: Repair a conflicting crop date only from corroborating source timing and retain the original date evidence instead of dropping the observation.

title: Soil depth is reference-backed configuration data
situation: A numeric soil depth was initially written directly in Soil_profiles.
what_happened: The official validator rejected the value because Storage declared an observation reference. The build now stores depth in shared soil observations and writes a complete profile selection reference.
lesson: Inspect Storage before writing even apparently simple configuration properties such as soil depth.

title: Soil texture uses the field-specific canonical code
situation: The hidden soil inventory used DSSAT texture abbreviation L.
what_happened: The official validator rejected both the raw abbreviation and the description Loam. Other_codes.csv explicitly mapped DSSAT L to canonical LO, which passed.
lesson: Use the field-specific vocabulary code, not a similarly named list or the category description.

title: Proposed Dictionary ontology identifiers require explanation
situation: Source-supported harvest variables were proposed to preserve organ and harvest scope.
what_happened: The official Dictionary validator required ai_comments for the proposed ontology identifiers. Adding explicit package-local proposal explanations corrected the metadata without changing measurements.
lesson: Explain every package-local proposed ontology identifier in Dictionary ai_comments.

title: Weather_monthly can be completed from compatible daily source measurements
situation: Weather_monthly remained header-only because no workbook comments or weather files directly reported monthly records.
what_happened: The follow-up source review compared the exact monthly target definitions with real daily measurements. Complete calendar-day groups supported 432 station-month rows containing mean SRAD, mean TMAX, mean TMIN and total RAIN. Dictionary and row comments explicitly label the values as derived, and the official validator passed.
lesson: Before leaving a summary table empty, check whether complete real source measurements support its exact declared aggregation, while clearly distinguishing derived summaries from directly reported observations.

title: Audit populated irrigation depths, not event dates alone
situation: The irrigation parser used a nonexistent shorthand target instead of irrig_amount_depth.
what_happened: A source-value completeness review found 495 dated events without their reported depths. The build was corrected to use IRVAL/irrig_amount_depth and seasonal totals were rebuilt.
lesson: Compare populated source measurements with populated target fields; row counts alone cannot detect silently omitted irrigation depths.

title: Normalize swapped SYN04 irrigation cells
situation: SYN04 IRVAL cells held IR operation codes while IROP cells held depths.
what_happened: After restoring amounts, the total calculation exposed nonnumeric IR004/IR001 values. Source rows consistently swapped the two columns; the parser normalized them and retained originals in comments.
lesson: Repair consistently exchanged numeric/code source columns from source types before mapping or aggregation.

title: Reconcile auxiliary rows field by field
situation: Ownership-linked PULU rows had blank metadata, cultivar and phenology cells alongside complementary canonical values.
what_happened: A completeness review found missing genotype names and lost complementary summaries after whole-row selection. Nonblank ownership-linked values now supplement rather than erase canonical source fields, with the explicit cultivar register applied.
lesson: Select complementary source values field by field rather than replacing a populated canonical row with a sparse auxiliary row.

title: Recognize all comment management syntaxes
situation: Comments used Soil preparation, undated environmental radiation protocols and paired maximum/minimum-temperature operations.
what_happened: Table counts found tillage empty and environmental records below the 15 source comments. Parsing was expanded for each source syntax and source-supported entire-season timing.
lesson: Compare comment record counts with reconstructed management records; a parser matching only one label can miss a whole management type.

title: Use existing TUNA for the exact tissue aggregate
situation: Harvest comments reported nitrogen in tubers, stems and leaves.
what_happened: A semantic review found tops-only CNAM was not equivalent and that a proposed duplicate was unnecessary because TUNA already covers the exact aggregate. The build now uses tuber_stem_leaf_N.
lesson: Search definitions and tissue scope for an exact existing variable before using a narrower field or proposing a duplicate.

title: Repair repeated summary identity using phenology
situation: SYN10 summary row179 repeated context19 and left context22 without a summary.
what_happened: The per-context count review found only 98 summaries. Emergence, harvest and endpoint evidence identified row179 as context22; preserving it under that identity yielded 99 summaries, matching source availability.
lesson: Investigate missing per-context coverage before consolidating duplicate IDs; phenology can establish that the rows represent distinct source contexts.

title: Use same-context boundaries for embedded soil measurements
situation: SYN06 NI1D/NH1D/SW1D numbered soil fields appeared within a crop observation section.
what_happened: The excluded-variable audit found genuine dated soil values missing. The parser expanded their four same-context initialization layers into soil timeseries using NOSLD, NHSLD and SWLD.
lesson: Route numbered soil fields by measurement object and actual layer grain instead of excluding them from a crop-only parser.

title: Recover numeric source cells with Excel date formatting
situation: Some biomass and irrigation amounts loaded as Excel date/time representations.
what_happened: Official validation rejected a root-weight value formatted as a 1901 date. Numeric fields now reverse Excel formatting with the appropriate serial conversion rather than treating the value as a measurement date.
lesson: Use the physical target type to distinguish Excel-formatted numeric serials from actual calendar dates.

title: Normalize numeric depth key serialization
situation: Equivalent depths were serialized as 40 and 40.0 in observation aggregation keys.
what_happened: Official validation detected duplicate logical soil keys. Numeric key components were normalized without changing their physical boundaries.
lesson: Canonicalize numeric key serialization before consolidating observations or constructing references.

title: Repair the layer context before constructing intervals
situation: SYN09 row52 contained context25 although it completed context16’s fourth-layer sequence.
what_happened: Official validation found a reversed 90-to-20 interval. The source ID was repaired before successive tops were calculated, preserving both full four-layer sequences.
lesson: Resolve a misplaced source context ID before calculating layer boundaries; do not patch the resulting reversed interval.

title: Consolidate fertilizer materials at declared event grain
situation: Multiple fertilizer material lines shared treatment and date keys.
what_happened: Official validation reported duplicate fertilizer event keys. Additive elemental nutrients were summed at target grain, while source material codes and original evidence were retained in comments.
lesson: Consolidate same-event material lines using compatible additive nutrients, never by treating nutrient sums as product mass.

title: Select ownership-linked management exports once
situation: Canonical and auxiliary workbooks repeated irrigation applications for the same owned contexts.
what_happened: Official validation found duplicate event keys. The explicitly owning management register was selected and 25 repeated canonical exports were retained as lineage instead of being added again.
lesson: Establish ownership and duplicate-export status before summing same-key management records.

title: Check exact mass aliases and reported units
situation: The parser mistakenly aliased UYFAD to nonexistent UYAFD and initially retained reported Mg/ha magnitudes.
what_happened: The excluded-variable and source-unit reviews caught lost fresh-weight values and missing scaling. Exact UYFAD mappings and reported Mg/ha/t/ha-to-kg/ha conversions restored structured data.
lesson: Verify exact target codes and source mass basis together; similar aliases and compatible-looking magnitudes can silently lose or mis-scale measurements.

title: Follow the explicit soil-library register
situation: IAHM000001 was initially associated with the unrelated LIBM fine-sand profile.
what_happened: The profile provenance review found the supplied counterpart register instead links the source documentation identity to IB00000009. The build corrected the library selection while retaining the original workbook profile ID.
lesson: Use explicit profile-register relationships, not physical similarity or a convenient library entry, to select profile observations.

title: Restrict weather lineage to selected source files
situation: Dictionary and provenance originally listed all weather files despite selecting only baseline records.
what_happened: The source-file audit exposed unused scenarios and an unreferenced station as apparent contributors. Lineage now lists selected files, and unselected alternatives are explicitly excluded.
lesson: Construct provenance from the selected measurement records rather than all files visited by a parser.

title: Require observed inputs for seasonal nutrient lineage
situation: Seasonal P/K Dictionary mappings were generated for a workbook with no reported P/K amounts.
what_happened: Official validation found mapped/excluded conflicts. Aggregate mappings are now emitted only when the workbook contributes actual nutrient measurements.
lesson: Generate aggregate lineage only for observed contributing variables, not every potential column in a source header.

title: Inspect monthly rainfall input identity
situation: Monthly records initially contained temperature/radiation averages but no rainfall totals.
what_happened: A populated-field review found daily precipitation was stored in precipitation, while the aggregation used the blank rainfall field. The build now sums the correct daily variable.
lesson: Use the populated field with the exact physical variable identity when deriving summaries from a schema containing similar names.

title: Keep initialization carbon identity distinct from stable carbon
situation: The source selected a dated organic-carbon campaign for initialization, but the target configuration layer has no same-variable column.
what_happened: Official validation rejected adding existing SAOC to a new table scope. Real campaign observations remain in the registered soil table, and initialization comments preserve the protocol selection without coding total carbon as stable carbon.
lesson: Do not substitute a different carbon pool to force a configuration reference; retain supported measurements and explicitly document a configuration-scope limitation.

title: Dictionary proposal metadata must be complete
situation: Official validator rejected missing source units and unnamespaced proposal codes.
what_happened: Added explicit not-reported source-unit labels and complete namespaced proposal metadata and explanations.
lesson: Declare full Dictionary metadata before registering proposed fields.

title: Recover numeric XLSX payloads from accidental date styles
situation: Official validator encountered1904/1914 dates in dry-weight columns.
what_happened: Inspected cell styles and recovered exact numeric XML payloads while retaining original date-format artifacts in comments.
lesson: For explicitly numeric measurement columns, recover numeric XML payloads rather than treating date styles as measured dates.

title: Trailing E weather numbers are not exponents
situation: Weather parsing failed on numeric tokens ending in E without exponent digits.
what_happened: Reused prior human decision to strip only the invalid trailing E, preserve numeric prefixes and document raw tokens.
lesson: Apply trailing-E repairs only to the documented malformed pattern and retain the source token.

title: Repair reversed irrigation amount and operation cells by type
situation: Official validator found an IR004 method code in an amount field.
what_happened: Source review found a consistently reversed SYN04 block; swapped only registered IR codes paired with numeric amounts and preserved originals.
lesson: Use source definitions and unambiguous code/number types to repair cell reversal, not blind column assumptions.

title: Definition-backed exclamation headers contain real events
situation: Source-count review found SYN03 irrigation variables hidden under exclamation headers.
what_happened: Mapped explicit Irrigation amount and Irrigation type code definitions and recovered the dated events.
lesson: Do not discard a column solely because its code header is an exclamation mark when its definition establishes a real variable.

title: Management statements are not dated irrigation applications
situation: Official validator rejected No irrigation was applied as an event date.
what_happened: Stored rain-fed and irrigated-without-event statements on irrigation treatments without fake event dates.
lesson: Classify treatment statements separately from actual application events.

title: Singleton observations require an explicit represented scope
situation: Official validator rejected blank group_plot_season_ids.
what_happened: Filled single-context observations and initial layers with the real anchor ID and regenerated references.
lesson: A single represented plot-season still needs an explicit singleton group scope.

title: Canonicalize numeric components of source keys
situation: Official validator detected duplicate observation keys represented as15 and15.0.
what_happened: Normalized numeric merge-key representations upstream and merged compatible same-grain records.
lesson: Normalize numeric keys before consolidating source records.

title: Use explicit comment intervals rather than row order
situation: Official validator detected a90-to20cm inverted initial layer in SYN09.
what_happened: Comments supplied65–90 and0–20cm boundaries; used those and consolidated an exact repeated65–90cm record without altering context IDs.
lesson: Source-stated intervals take precedence over incidental row ordering.

title: Use field-specific canonical soil texture codes
situation: Official validator rejected both L and the display label Loam.
what_happened: Read Other_codes and used canonical LO with documented DSSAT alias L.
lesson: Use the field-specific canonical category code, not a display label or a legacy alias.

title: Unspecified horizon tokens are not horizon identities
situation: Official validator rejected a hyphen master-horizon token.
what_happened: Retained the hyphen in provenance and left the unknown horizon value missing.
lesson: Do not interpret punctuation placeholders as master-horizon categories.

title: Repair a broken metadata ID only with accepted correspondence
situation: Source metadata contained SYN07 #REF! without context7.
what_happened: Asked human, confirmed the unique downstream correspondence and preserved the inferred association and original error.
lesson: A broken local ID needs explicit evidence and human-accepted provenance, not a fabricated context.

title: Preserve both rows when a repeated summary ID is misassociated
situation: Count reconciliation found two SYN10 summary rows19 and no22.
what_happened: Human approved row179 association to22 after checking emergence and harvest against its planting and timeseries.
lesson: Resolve a duplicate summary association using within-source date correspondence rather than averaging or dropping it.

title: Unmatched series aliases can be source-supported IDs
situation: Official validator found SYN10 series IDs104 and110 without parents.
what_happened: Reused human mapping104→4 and110→10, retained all six samples and documented proposed alias mappings.
lesson: Investigate orphan series IDs and retain every supported observation through explicit source-key reconciliation.

title: Unlinked source evidence must remain unlinked
situation: Official references failed for SYN01 context999 and SYN09 HIAD-only context999.
what_happened: Reused human evidence-only decisions, preserving complete raw rows/values outside final relational tables without invented links.
lesson: Preserve unlinked evidence explicitly rather than assigning it to a plausible existing context.

title: Pad explicit ISO-like date text without locale reinterpretation
situation: Official validator rejected2004-05-3.
what_happened: Reused human normalization guidance to trim and zero-pad the stated year/month/day.
lesson: Normalize explicit calendar components without swapping or guessing their meaning.

title: SYN07 emergence repairs require inferred-status provenance
situation: Official validator found emergence before October planting.
what_happened: Human approved November3/6 interpretations for the two specified dates and both repeated reports, with originals preserved.
lesson: Document human-approved day/month repairs as inferred, not independently verified.

title: Repair wrong January years from accepted sampling correspondence
situation: Official validator found seven January samples before establishment.
what_happened: Human approved advancing only the year after checking neighbouring14-day sample sequences; kept originals and inference status.
lesson: Use source sampling-sequence evidence and explicit approval for year-rollover repairs.

title: Harvest management and final sampling can expose a copied date
situation: Official validator found SYN10:13 final sample outside its management interval.
what_happened: Human approved November2 harvest from its summary/final sample rather than neighbouring context10 October27.
lesson: Investigate cross-context copying before changing a final observation date.

title: Resolve source genotypes before creating parent records
situation: Final validator found unused genotype parents from early blank auxiliary cultivar reports.
what_happened: Looked up named cultivar evidence for the same canonical context before creating genotype rows.
lesson: Consolidate same-context genotype evidence before parent creation rather than creating superseded blank parents.

title: Confirm source and target planting-depth units before converting
situation: Mapping review caught an unnecessary mm-to-cm conversion.
what_happened: Confirmed both source and target PLDP use millimetres and retained original numeric depths.
lesson: Never apply a depth conversion merely because another soil-depth field uses centimetres.

title: Existing chemical amount already represents active ingredient
situation: Field-definition review found an unnecessary proposed active-ingredient variable.
what_happened: Mapped source active ingredient kg/ha directly to chemical_applic_amount whose definition explicitly covers active amount.
lesson: Read the full target definition before proposing a physically equivalent variable.

title: Convert oxide fertilizer bases separately from elemental records
situation: Source-unit review found SYN10 P2O5 and K2O amounts had been loaded as elemental P/K.
what_happened: Applied source-supported stoichiometric ratios from supplied atomic masses only to oxide-basis records and documented them.
lesson: Preserve chemical basis when converting fertilizer amounts; do not apply oxide factors to already elemental data.

title: Retain material identities at a consolidated fertilizer-event grain
situation: Excluded-column review found observed FECD material codes with no standard event field.
what_happened: Proposed material-code lists, retained material-specific source records in comments, and summed compatible same-event nutrients without treating repeated workbook reports as new applications.
lesson: Consolidating event amounts must not erase source material identity or double-count repeated reports.

title: Loaded soil worksheet values still need accurate source mappings
situation: Excluded-column review found SYN07 Soils values loaded through profile logic but labeled excluded in Dictionary.
what_happened: Added exact workbook-to-observation/configuration mappings and preserved shared profile scope.
lesson: Dictionary provenance must follow the actual source path even when another source-processing branch writes the values.

title: Soil site coordinates must not disappear with library metadata
situation: Source-code review found nonmissing soil LAT/LONG without target mappings.
what_happened: Stored reported site coordinates as shared observation-backed proposed profile properties, independently of plot/weather coordinates.
lesson: Retain explicit soil-site coordinates without substituting another entity coordinate.

title: Preserve laboratory sample intervals and selected baseline purpose
situation: Source review found successive SYN08 campaign bases represented as overlapping0-to-base samples.
what_happened: Restored successive intervals and referenced the dated campaign for explicitly documented initialization baseline, without relabeling it stable carbon.
lesson: Keep measurement timing/layers and configuration purpose distinct when selecting initial organic-carbon evidence.

title: Use matched publication authority for PULU N schedules
situation: Protocol comparison exposed copied positive N amounts in N0 and mismatched factor levels.
what_happened: Reused explicit human publication-governed schedules by source ID, kept local dates and independent P/K events, and preserved originals.
lesson: Correct nutrient schedules only from explicitly matched governing evidence, never from yield trends.

title: PULU treatment yields must not use an across-factor mean
situation: Publication comparison identified three I2.0 values matching the Mean column.
what_happened: Reused the human decision to write29.3/32.1/34.4Mg/ha consistently in summary and endpoint reports and preserve the originals.
lesson: Keep treatment-specific yields separate from across-treatment statistics.

title: Do not override an explicit organic event date with a header note
situation: Final annotation review found a generic OMDAT=PDATE header had overridden the actual DITY1982-04-19 date.
what_happened: Preserved the explicit event date and mapped the actual40tonne fresh annotation separately from5000kg dry mass.
lesson: A generic header note cannot override an explicit dated record, and fresh/dry masses must remain distinct.

title: Explain corroborated endpoint selection without rescaling a curve
situation: Conflict review found SYN08:4 same-date endpoints1730 and17300kg/ha.
what_happened: Selected the ownership-linked PULU17300kg/ha endpoint corroborated by17.3Mg/ha summary, retained raw alternative in comments and left other growth dates unchanged.
lesson: Resolve a conflicting endpoint from corroborating source reports without rescaling the entire growth curve.
